Definition: from G1909 and G3140; to attest further, i.e. corroborate:--testify.
BiblicalUsage: Epimartyreo means to testify further, to corroborate — and Peter writes by Silvanus, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.
TheologicalSignificance: Not new doctrine, but a witness that the grace they stand in is the true grace of God: that is Peter's parting gift, I believe.
